Bill.BriefDescription: Requiring disclosure of the long-term fiscal impacts of budget proposals.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to budget sustainability; and adding a new sectionto chapter 43.88 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 43.88 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The full disclosure of the longterm fiscal impacts of budgetproposals under consideration by the legislature will improve theinformed participation in the budget process of the citizens of thestate and their legislators and contribute to the sustainable use ofthe state's limited fiscal resources. For each proposed omnibusoperating appropriations bill reported by a legislative fiscalcommittee or approved by either house of the legislature, the relevantfiscal committee shall provide a public report that documents thepolicylevel proposals in the bill and the cost of each proposal in thecurrent fiscal biennium and the estimated cost in the next ensuingfiscal biennium. This information shall also be provided by thegovernor for each proposed omnibus operating appropriations bill p. 1 SB 5930submitted to the legislature by the governor.
